_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "authentications" ("provider" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "token" TEXT NOT NULL, "refresh_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "token_expire" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("provider"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "caches" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customData" TEXT NOT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "check_ins" ("history_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_item_trakt" INTEGER NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("history_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "episode_images" ("show_trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stillUrl" TEXT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("show_trakt_id", "season", "episode"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movie_images" ("movie_trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "posterUrl" TEXT NULL, "bannerUrl" TEXT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("movie_trakt_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "season_images" ("show_trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "posterUrl" TEXT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("show_trakt_id", "season"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "show_images" ("show_trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "posterUrl" TEXT NULL, "bannerUrl" TEXT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("show_trakt_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shows" ("id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_tmdb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_tvdb" INTEGER NULL, "id_imdb" TEXT NULL, "id_slug" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id_trakt"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "show_summaries" ("id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "overview" TEXT NULL, "first_aired" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "runtime" INTEGER NULL, "certification" TEXT NULL, "network" TEXT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "trailer" TEXT NULL, "homepage" TEXT NULL, "rating" REAL NOT NULL, "votes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "comment_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "aired_episodes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "airs_day" TEXT NULL, "airs_time" TEXT NULL, "airs_timezone" TEXT NULL, "genres" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id_trakt"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "seasons" ("id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_tmdb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_tvdb" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "show_trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id_trakt"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "genres" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "slug" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name", "type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "posters" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "watched" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("watched" IN (0, 1)), "watch_listed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("watch_listed" IN (0, 1)), "dropped" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("dropped" IN (0, 1)), "season_premiere" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("season_premiere" IN (0, 1)), "season_finale" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("season_finale" IN (0, 1)), "series_finale" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("series_finale" IN (0, 1)), "mid_season_finale" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("mid_season_finale" IN (0, 1)), "rating" TEXT NULL, "user_rating" TEXT NULL, "poster_url" TEXT NULL, "no_poster_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "loading" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("loading" IN (0, 1)), "loading_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "poster_url_last_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "poster_data_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "episodes" ("id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_tmdb" INTEGER NULL, "id_tvdb" INTEGER NULL, "id_imdb" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "show_trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synchronized_summary_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id_trakt"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "episode_summaries" ("id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "overview" TEXT NULL, "rating" REAL NOT NULL, "votes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "comment_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "availableTranslations" TEXT NOT NULL, "runtime" INTEGER NULL, "first_aired" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "episode_type" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id_trakt"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movies" ("id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_tmdb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_imdb" TEXT NULL, "id_slug" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id_trakt"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_ratings" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_item_trakt" INTEGER NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "id_trakt", "season", "episode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watchlists" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_item_trakt" INTEGER NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "listed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "id_trakt", "season", "episode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_people" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "show_trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "person_trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_tmdb_id" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "characters" TEXT NOT NULL, "profilePath" TEXT NULL, "cast_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "show_trakt_id", "season", "episode", "person_trakt_id", "role"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_people_syncs" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "show_trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "images_synchronized_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "show_trakt_id", "season", "episode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dropped_items" ("id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_tmdb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_tvdb" INTEGER NULL, "id_imdb" TEXT NULL, "id_slug" TEXT NOT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id_trakt"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trakt_history_items" ("history_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id_item_trakt" INTEGER NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "watched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("history_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trakt_watched_items" ("trakt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "watched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plays" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "trakt_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trakt_show_progress_items" ("id_trakt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "aired" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_watched_at" INTEGER NULL, "reset_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id_trakt"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trakt_season_progress_items" ("trakt_show_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "aired" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("trakt_show_id", "season"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trakt_episode_progress_items" ("trakt_show_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("trakt_show_id", "season", "episode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trakt_last_activity_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "all" INTEGER NOT NULL, "movies_watched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "movies_collected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "movies_rated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "movies_watchlisted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "movies_recommendations_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "movies_commented_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "movies_paused_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "movies_hidden_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episodes_watched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episodes_collected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episodes_rated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episodes_watchlisted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episodes_commented_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episodes_paused_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shows_rated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shows_watchlisted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shows_recommendations_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shows_commented_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shows_hidden_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seasons_rated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seasons_watchlisted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seasons_commented_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seasons_hidden_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "watchlist_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recommendations_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_settings_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lists_liked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lists_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "list_commented_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "up_next_episode_items" ("trakt_show_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "trakt_episode_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("trakt_show_id", "season", "episode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_states" ("sync_type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "history_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL, "up_next_to_watch" INTEGER NOT NULL, "userMessage" TEXT NULL, "start_sync_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_sync_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("sync_type_id"));
